newsitem.title: USA: Kewaunee nuclear plant restart delayed.
newsitem.headline: Kewaunee nuclear plant restart delayed.

text.p: Wisconsin Public Service Corp said Monday that the Kewaunee Nuclear Power Plant is not expected to resume operations until at least mid-June as repairs to steam generators take longer than expected.
The plant is jointly owned by Madison Gas and Electric Co, Wisconsin Public Service, a unit of WPS Resources Corp, and WPL Holdings Inc's Wisconsin Power and Light Co.
Additional repairs will run $4.5 million to $10 million, Wisconsin Public Service said.
The plant has been out of service since September 21 when it was shutdown for a refueling and maintenance outage, the company said.
The plant was originally expected to resume operations in the first quarter of 1997.
